contexts.text: They can hardly be brought to receive the truths which are contrary to their falsities.
When, therefore, it treats in the Word of those things which are contrary to the Divine...
The evils and falsities with which goods and truths cannot be mingled, are those which are contrary to love to God and to love towards the neighbour.
The historicals are not contrary to each other.
If there is contrariety (between the exterior and the interior man)...
The cause of abomination is that they are contrary to their principles and loves...
Through desolations and temptations are perceived the states contrary to heavenly life... The sense and perception of happiness only come from the relation to contraries.

Things of the light of Heaven become darkness when they fall into those which are of the light of the world, for in themselves they are contrary; in order for them not to be contrary, man is regenerated...
There are Spirits who persuade contraries...
The quality of good is known from its contrary: all perception of a thing is according to reflection relative to the differences from contraries...
If the affection is contrary to the man's affection...
How contrary is the education of children now...

Opposites have no relation among each other, but are contraries; relatives are between the greatest and least of the same thing; but contraries are, from opposition, against them, and among themselves are relatives...
You will see that the things which are said are turned into the contraries...
Two things which are contrary to each other...
Such Spirits are wont to think contraries...
Thus mercy is turned into the contrary with Spirits of such a nature.
There are two contraries in man and Spirit. Explained.

Contrary things would continually confound them: wherefore it is of the Lord's Providence that one finds so many contraries in every particular... that, being confounded by so many contraries, they may remain in universal truths...
There are, moreover, indefinite contrary objects which induce falsities.
Where there is enlightenment there must be a view of contraries.
